chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Muhammad ibn Isma'il from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Safwan ibn Yahya from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj from one who narrated to him from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding a man who divorces his wife while he is ill, he said: 'If he dies in his illness and she remains waiting for him (in her waiting period) and has not remarried, she inherits him; and if she has already remarried, then she has accepted what he did, so there is no inheritance for her.'
ai.seo_question: Does a wife inherit if her husband dies of the same illness during which he divorced her?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the status of a woman in the *Iddah* of a revocable divorce (*Taliqah*) when her husband dies during his illness. It establishes that remarriage during this interim period constitutes a final acceptance of the divorce, thereby severing the inheritance link, whereas remaining unmarried preserves her right to inherit as a full wife. This ruling highlights the Shia juristic view that the marital bond remains active until the *Iddah* concludes or is explicitly terminated by remarriage.
